ऐतिहासिक a. (की f.) [इतिहास
ठक्]
1 Traditional.
--2
Historical.
--कः
1 An historian.
--2 One
who knows or studies ancient
legends.

ऐतिह्यं Traditional instruction,
legendary account; ऐतिह्यमनुमानं च
प्रत्यक्षमपि चागमम् Rām.; किलेत्यैतिह्ये.
(ऐतिह्य is regarded as one of the
Pramāṇas or proofs by the Paurāṇika as
and reckoned along with प्रत्यक्ष
अनुमान &c.; see अनुभव).
